description: This file defines interfaces and structures related to managing a sparse index in a version control system, including functions for index expansion, sparsity management, and configuration.

methods.name: is_sparse_index_allowed
methods.description: Checks if sparse index operations are permitted based on provided flags.

methods.name: convert_to_sparse
methods.description: Converts a given index to a sparse representation based on provided flags.

methods.name: ensure_correct_sparsity
methods.description: Ensures the index has the correct sparsity configuration.

methods.name: clear_skip_worktree_from_present_files
methods.description: Clears skip worktree flags from present files in the index.

methods.name: expand_to_path
methods.description: Expands the index entries to include a specific path and its descendants if they are sparse directories.

methods.name: set_sparse_index_config
methods.description: Sets the sparse index configuration for the repository.

methods.name: expand_index
methods.description: Expands a sparse index according to a pattern list or fully if pattern list is null.

methods.name: ensure_full_index
methods.description: Ensures the index is fully expanded.
